context.content: >The one year expiry is weird. Only the certificates expire. You better get ready for them becuase they are the most useful thing in the world but also a pain the first 100 times. This things allow for secure online identification and the best thing of all, signing things without printing them. Once you have it all set it up, downloading some apps and stuff like that, you just connect your phone to the PC via a normal USB, place the ID on top of your smartphone, click on the pdf that you want to sign it, select your signature from the list and place it where you want it. They look like [this](https://www.google.com/search?q=firma+electronica+dni+pdf&tbm=isch&ved=2ahUKEwiuqcPL2IfyAhXmgM4BHbhABBUQ2-cCegQIABAB&oq=firma+electronica+dni+pdf&gs_lcp=ChJtb2JpbGUtZ3dzLXdpei1pbWcQAzoECAAQHjoECAAQGFDxygFY1NEBYILTAWgAcAB4AIABfogBwwSSAQMwLjWYAQCgAQHAAQE&sclient=mobile-gws-wiz-img&ei=A1ACYe6bPOaBur4PuIGRqAE&bih=678&biw=412&client=ms-android-att-us&prmd=ivn#imgrc=iczAIbPmEYDqiM) and now the pdf has some messages like "This PDF is secure and all the the signatures are valid".
